bio: Underscored a network with collisions, and retransmissions, and back-off.
name: Robert Metcalfe

pieces.content:
It is difficult to talk and
making it easier does not
make it any easier to
talk in a hoop or through an un-
remembered or lit-up eitherware.
There are incorrect capital
soothsayers and they swerve into
luminiferous layers and
they tell you it can't and won't work
and they long for large fruit and
they are as local as can be.
pieces.readme: For Bob Metcalfe on what I imagine is his birthday ?
pieces.title: Eitherware advancing
